selection: Five explicit externally verifiable factual claims from the justification of each final answer; fixed before verification. Deliberate sample, not a random accuracy estimate.

independent_ai_review.assessor: critic in a separate context, no author reasoning; not human assessment
independent_ai_review.artifact_reviewed_for_agent: agent-strategy.md (saved project artifact); main findings also apply to the differently formatted final answer
chat_strengths: Opened current official Yandex and Mail help pages
Main metric combines payment and use by at least two people
agent_strengths: Two full paid cycles after promotion
Missing event data is not treated as inactivity
Scripted numerical illustration and randomized integration comparison
chat_gaps: Offer versus no promotion estimates a bundle effect, not the effect of payment alone
Recruitment period and each family's follow-up duration need separate specification
agent_gaps: Integration versus direct-purchase link does not isolate the channel or payment mechanism
One active invitee does not establish use by two people; renewal and family-use thresholds are not linked
joint_findings: No direct promise exceeds the proposed product: both condition sales on readiness
Success of partner tariff alone does not justify own cloud development
